title: A general synthesis method for small-size and water-soluble NaYF4:Yb, Ln upconversion nanoparticles at high temperature
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,38689-38696
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07543A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Mingda Liu, Jianwen Xu, Kai Zhu, Ming Yan, Min He, Xiaowei Huang, Yan Xu, Wei Wang, Shibo Zhao, Qinghui Zeng
In this work, we have developed a general synthesis method for the small size (<50 nm) and water-soluble lanthanide ions doped NaYF4 upconversion nanoparticles using triethylene glycol as a higher temperature solvent and diacid as surfactant.
